name: Avenge My Village
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.

adventurer, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.
narrative.objectives: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.
narrative.offerRewardText: adventurer, I thank you... but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 18, 2,700 XP in all.
